business_summary: CyberStep Holdings, Inc. develops online games in Japan. It operates through Online Game Business, Entertainment Business, and Others segments. The company offers GetAmped, Steel Chronicles C21 and C21, GetAmped 2, Cosmic Break, Onigiri, Cosmic Break 2, Cosmic Break Sora no Sentai, Online Crane Game Toreba 2D, Q&Q Answers, Touch! Gudetama ~3rd Time's the Charm~, Elysion of Conflict, Akatsuki no Breakers, E-commerce service Mireba, KDJ-ONE, Tomotoru ~Hello Kitty and Happiness Life~, GetAmped Mobile, CosmicBreakUniversal, Happy Kuzutopia, Onigiri HEROES, CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH, Terabit, and BLACK STELLAPTOLOMEA online games. It is also involved in receiving orders for sound production for theatrical films, animations, and other video works, as well as serving on production committees; art, manufacturing, and wholesale businesses; and operation of e-commerce sites via the internet and the planning of digital content. In addition, the company engages in development of network entertainment software, distributed network libraries, research and development of 3D graphics engines, and licensing and operation of online game services. The company was formerly known as CyberStep, Inc. and changed its name to CyberStep Holdings, Inc. in December 2025. CyberStep Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Suginami, Japan.
